titles.title: Series I White & Blue Flower Shapes

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A floral form occupies much of this painting.  It is situated in front of a reddish background.  The lower portion of the flower is rounded and largely white in color.  It has a small spot of pink in the center.  The upper portion of the flower is made up of curving layers in shades of blue and green.  It has a tear-shaped spot of black in its center.
title: Series I White & Blue Flower Shapes
